description: Piani paesaggistici: Limitazioni di traffico is a series of datasets listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Provincia autonoma di Bolzano. Informazioni lineari del piano paesaggistico: limitazioni di traffico. Coverage: Provincia autonoma di Bolzano. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Provincia autonoma di Bolzano. Its tags are ambiente, bolzano, habitat-e-biotopi, limitazione-di-traffico, limitazioni-di-traffico. It offers 4 resource(s) in MAP_SRVC, OP_DATPRO. The portal shows 2026-09-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
